name: Symphyotrichum

study_strategy.warning: Many fall composites need comparison by structure, not just bloom color.

b071_study_strategy.warning: Symphyotrichum IDs are easy to over-simplify from flower color. Use vegetative characters, stem hair, leaf architecture, habitat, and current variety/subspecies names together.

quick_split: S. eulae — Texas endemic; scabrous serrate leaves, open panicle, white to pale lavender rays.
S. drummondii var. texanum — larger serrate lower leaves with winged petiole-like bases, much smaller upper leaves, short-hairy stems.
S. ericoides var. ericoides — many tiny stiff narrow leaves, short-strigose stems, masses of small white heads.
S. lanceolatum subsp. lanceolatum — tall moist-site white-panicle aster with narrow lanceolate leaves; range HOLD pending third exact target county.
